Keep glyco-omics names valid during SE operations

Source: R/se-names.R
se-name-operations.Rd

These methods preserve the complete, unique axis-name contract of GlycomicSE() and GlycoproteomicSE() during common SE operations. Repeated row or column selections, and binding objects with overlapping names on the bound axis, now error instead of returning an invalid object. Returned glyco-omics objects must also retain their required annotation fields. Use distinct observation identifiers before binding; keep repeated biological labels in annotation columns. Subsetting to zero rows or columns is supported.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'GlycomicSE'
names(x) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycomicSE'
rowData(x, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycomicSE,DataFrame'
colData(x, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycomicSE,NULL'
colData(x, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycomicSE,list'
assays(x, withDimnames = TRUE, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycomicSE,SimpleList'
assays(x, withDimnames = TRUE, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycomicSE,ANY,ANY,ANY'
x[i, j, ..., drop = TRUE]

# S4 method for class 'GlycomicSE,ANY,ANY,SummarizedExperiment'
x[i, j, ...] <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycomicSE'
rbind(..., deparse.level = 1)

# S4 method for class 'GlycomicSE'
cbind(..., deparse.level = 1)

# S4 method for class 'GlycoproteomicSE'
names(x) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycoproteomicSE'
rowData(x, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycoproteomicSE,DataFrame'
colData(x, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycoproteomicSE,NULL'
colData(x, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycoproteomicSE,list'
assays(x, withDimnames = TRUE, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycoproteomicSE,SimpleList'
assays(x, withDimnames = TRUE, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycoproteomicSE,ANY,ANY,ANY'
x[i, j, ..., drop = TRUE]

# S4 method for class 'GlycoproteomicSE,ANY,ANY,SummarizedExperiment'
x[i, j, ...] <- value

# S4 method for class 'GlycoproteomicSE'
rbind(..., deparse.level = 1)

# S4 method for class 'GlycoproteomicSE'
cbind(..., deparse.level = 1)

Arguments

x

A glyco-omics SE object.

value

Replacement names, annotations, assays, or a subexperiment.

...

Additional arguments passed to the parent SE method, or objects to bind.

withDimnames

Whether the parent SE method checks assay names.

i, j

Row and column indices.

drop

Passed to the parent SE method.

deparse.level

Passed to the parent binding method.

Value

A valid glyco-omics SE object.

Details

names(x) <- value is equivalent to replacing row names. Replacing colData follows SE's positional semantics and synchronizes its row names to the assay; supplied names must be complete and unique. To align differently ordered components by name, use the constructors. Replacement assays may be unnamed or have names identical to the object in the same order, even when withDimnames = FALSE; resolved names are stored on the replacement assay.

combineRows() and combineCols() retain their upstream behavior: they return an ordinary SummarizedExperiment, outside this subclass contract. Convert the result explicitly to restore glyco-omics validation.
